string.text: How long travel notifications stay on screen (seconds).
How fast the spectator camera moves during normal travel, as a multiple of sprint speed. Default 5x.
How fast the spectator camera moves during sneak travel, as a multiple of sprint speed. Default 2x.
Draw the planned route on the PDA map when you open a travel destination.
Blocks level transitions while an alerted enemy is engaging you within ambush range.
Show Ambush Range on PDA Map
Yellow ring = LoS ambush range (default 100m; weather, daylight, and sneaking shrink it). Enemies that go agro also interrupt travel.
Pause on Ambush / Hostiles at Destination

Freezes the game and shows Paused (same as the Pause key, not ESC) when travel ends in an ambush, or when hostiles are close to your destination (including alerted enemies at a zone exit). Press a movement key (WASD / your binds) or Pause to resume.
Press to pull companions to your position (skips waiting companions and locked hostages / rescue targets). Replaces Fair Fast Travel squad teleport and Quick Companion Teleport.

True Fast Travel: real-time spectator camera along the path. Places its own base/campfire map icons (no Fair Fast Travel needed for that). Unlock travel by walking near them (bases 50m, campfires/zone exits 30m) - unvisited ones say "Not visited yet". Guides ignore that. Journeys cannot be cancelled once started. Optional keybind teleports companions to you. Disable Fair Fast Travel, Limited Fast Travel, and Quick Companion Teleport.
